title: Average days to ship placeholder
statementMd:
How many days are there between each customer's signup and their first order? Show customer name and days, customers with orders only.

Expected columns: `name`, `days_to_first_order`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name, CAST(julianday(MIN(o.order_date)) - julianday(c.signup_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_to_first_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
